profile.name: Search and Compare Flights

procedure.intent: Open a browser and navigate to Google Flights
Enter the origin city in the origin field
Enter the destination city in the destination field
Trigger the search to view flight results
Halt once the results list is visible (submit-ready)

decision_rules: Search on Google Flights, not the generic Google search results
Always specify both origin and destination explicitly
Set clear departure and return dates
Halt at the results list — do not click any individual flight
